message: So, I was at a friend's place the other night, and we were cooking up a storm when suddenly the smoke alarm started going off. My friend, bless her heart, went into full-on panic mode, waving a dishtowel like it was a flag of surrender! 😅 It reminded me how important it is to have a calm escape plan and to check those smoke alarms regularly. Who knew a little kitchen chaos could teach such a valuable lesson? What's your go-to plan when things heat up?
